title: The operating point checked on 55 real tables: acting on the chosen share beats today's threshold
request: The owner's six-layer map: more ability beyond leakage; layer 5 (decide) measured before any student.
spec: agent_runs/live_tests/2026-10-25-threshold-methods/PLAN.md, written before any result: six ways of choosing the operating point, each acted on unseen rows; a rule change at 80% winner-or-within-noise, a student at 0.02 better than the best single way.
plan: Pre-register the methods, measures and decisions.
A dry run on an invented table.
60 real train-split tables, resumable, under the 80% rule.

decisions.decision: Two share methods were added after the dry run, before any real table.
decisions.why: The dry run showed the threshold chosen on out-of-fold scores acting on 16.8% of new rows where 20% were allowed: the comparison had to separate 'which point' from 'a score or a share'.

decisions.decision: The best share in hindsight is recorded for the label; the first 14 tables lack it.
decisions.why: Results are never edited; those lines carry no measured label.

change: agent_runs/live_tests/2026-10-25-threshold-methods (PLAN, measure, REPORT); evidence/campaigns/ability_v1 (ABL-001); the measured decisions written by ability_records into the measurement's ledger (440 records); STUDENTS_100_PLAN S8.

findings.defect: Today's operating point loses value on new rows.
findings.scenario: On 55 real tables, the argmax threshold lost 12.4% of the attainable value on unseen rows; with 1,000 positives or more 9.1%, against 0.3% for the share.
findings.cause: A threshold chosen on out-of-fold scores is applied to the scores of the model refitted on all rows, which sit a little lower at the top.
findings.fix: Next: act on the chosen share (bagged over draws) for a batch; for a stream, re-anchor the threshold on recent scores; measured once on the dev tables before decide.py changes.

measurements.name: layer 5 on real tables
measurements.gate: the plan's decision rule, fixed before any result
measurements.result: 55 tables (5 refused: fewer than 20 of a class), 432 statements; mean regret: argmax 0.124, bagged 0.092, argmax_share 0.060, bagged_share 0.055, bayes 0.074, bayes_iso 0.064; bagged_share winner or within noise 0.868; a state picker 0.108

outcome: A rule change candidate for the decide layer, measured on real tables; a student is not needed there.
lessons: A rule that wins most often can still lose the most: count how much is lost, not only how often it wins.
risks: The share policy fits batches; a stream needs its threshold re-anchored on recent scores.
